reason: The raw concept-sprite voxelization and first curated pass had weak material separation and vanilla trident hand transforms made the oversized cuboid geometry float beside the player; this pass adds explicit material colors, face-aware shading, brighter readable prongs, driftwood grip, copper/verdigris bands, an amethyst focus core, a stronger dark silhouette, compact hand-anchored held/throwing transforms, GUI inventory routing that reuses the richer existing flat trident sprite, and a projectile item definition used by the custom thrown-harpoon renderer; later regenerated by tools/generate_3d_models.py as a hand-authored showcase silhouette with tapered tines, barbed prongs, glow fins, kelp ribbons, and a rotated crown-gem shell at the same held-pose envelope.
